EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in History (secondary education) at ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear Future Sun Devil,
Thank you for expressing interest in the History (Secondary Education) (BA: https://newcollege.asu.edu/history-secondary-education-degree) program at Arizona State University. For students considering a career in education, this flexible program fully prepares students for teaching and certification while providing all the disciplinary knowledge of a traditional history degree. Students will understand history in all its breadth and depth while developing strong critical reading, writing and research skills as well as skills in oral presentation. Students usually look to work as History teachers, Archivists, Curators, Regulatory Affairs Managers, Editors, and Historians among many others. By viewing the major map (https://webapp4.asu.edu/programs/t5/roadmaps/ASU00/ASHISSEBA/null/ALL/2016), you can see the degree requirements outlined for graduation.
Be sure to review our admission and application requirements (https://students.asu.edu/freshman/requirements) for more information about the application process in an easy to follow format. For more ways to pay for college, please visit our scholarships page (https://newcollege.asu.edu/college-scholarships).
It's important to find the right fit for your undergraduate program. A great way to learn more about this degree is to register for one of our upcoming information sessions. You can visit ASU and register for a tour (https://visit.asu.edu/).
We can’t wait to see you here at West campus! If you have any questions about New College, West campus, or one of our 35 programs, please contact our Recruitment Office through the information listed below. Thank you, and we’ll talk to you soon!
Kindest Regards,
New College Recruitment Team New College of Interdisciplinary Arts and Sciences Arizona State University, West campus asknewcollege@asu.edu 602-543-2890 {!Case.Thread_Id}
